method: Current official patriarchal, diocesan, and parish directories were used to establish Singapore bodies. Search engines and maps were used only to discover first-party sources. No body was inferred from population, clergy visits, or an unofficial listing.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current metropolitan directory names one Singapore congregation, the Holy Resurrection Cathedral. It is published under the Metropolitanate of Singapore.

The current exarchal directory and parish site name one Singapore congregation, the Dormition parish. A 2026 patriarchal report confirms its current church life. It is published under the Diocese of Singapore.
The current official external communities directory was checked and did not name a Singapore body. This records the bounded audit result, not a claim that a body could never exist.
The current official diocesan and linked diaspora material was checked and did not name a Singapore body. This records the bounded audit result, not a claim that a body could never exist.
